Downtown Glendale.name: Downtown Glendale
Downtown Glendale.description: Historic downtown core on Glendale Avenue with the Antique Row shopping district, Murphy Park, and steady storefront commercial-renovation permitting around the Water Tower.

Ocotillo / 43rd Ave Corridor.name: Ocotillo / 43rd Ave Corridor
Ocotillo / 43rd Ave Corridor.description: Southeast council-district corridor of post-war tract housing and neighborhood retail along 43rd/51st avenues with renovation-led 311 and business-license churn.

Westgate.name: Westgate
Westgate.description: West Valley entertainment district anchored by State Farm Stadium, Desert Diamond Arena, and the Westgate dining/retail row with high hospitality license density.

Manistee Estates.name: Manistee Estates
Manistee Estates.description: Established residential district west of downtown with the historic Manistee Ranch, mature-canopy lots, and steady addition/renovation permitting.

Grand Avenue / Barrel Corridor.name: Grand Avenue / Barrel Corridor
Grand Avenue / Barrel Corridor.description: West-central corridor along Grand Avenue with light-industrial, warehouse, and auto-services business licensing and water/sewer service-request volume.

51st Ave / Cactus District.name: 51st Ave / Cactus District
51st Ave / Cactus District.description: East-central district hugging the Phoenix border with mid-century housing, strip-retail revitalization, and strong trash/street service-request cadence.

Arrowhead.name: Arrowhead
Arrowhead.description: Master-planned northeast Glendale around Arrowhead Towne Center with golf-course estates, big-box retail, and the city's highest-value new-construction permits.

Thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
Thunderbird.description: Northeast neighborhoods along Thunderbird Road near the Thunderbird School / ASU West campus with mixed multifamily and commercial infill.

Sahuaro Ranch.name: Sahuaro Ranch
Sahuaro Ranch.description: Northwest district around historic Sahuaro Ranch Park with tract-housing renovation, ranchette lots, and retail-anchored corridors at 59th/67th avenues.
